request_budget_basis: Pooled 18 per unique normalized input globally, up to 40 per company; explicit lower limits honored

measured_request_projection.note: Projection from a measured sample; source pagination/retries and feed changes can differ.

dns_scope: prechecks, website preflight and pinned-transport connection resolutions

search.price_note: estimate at configured unit price; one query per company; no free credit assumed

hiring_prefetch.forward_name_fallback_scope: known legal/brand/subunit names; unknown trading names remain a discovery risk

event_loop.scope: whole run after input entry; includes source processing and output generation

system_awake_request.scope: active batch only; idle sleep request; no persistent setting changes
